rules.node_selection: All rows of the paired upstream Completeness_783.csv, in source order; require Completed=True. No nodes added from annotations.
rules.connectivity_selection: All rows of the paired upstream Connectivity_783.parquet, without edge threshold, pruning, or sign changes.
rules.row_grain: One directed presynaptic/postsynaptic neuron pair per row, independently verified unique. The exported pandas index is ignored.
rules.aggregation: No runtime aggregation; Connectivity is the supplied positive integer synaptic-contact count per directed neuron pair.
rules.neurotransmitter_sign: Excitatory is the upstream model sign per presynaptic neuron, +1 or -1. It is validated against the supplied signed count and is not overwritten using later annotations.
rules.weights: The neural model applies its separately registered global weight to Excitatory x Connectivity. No weight fitting occurs in the loader.
rules.annotations: Exact root-ID joins to frozen v783 annotations. Unknown type, side, or neurotransmitter remain unknown. Additional annotated cells are not execution nodes.
rules.identifiers: Python int64/integer; decimal strings at JSON/browser boundaries. No floating-point conversion.
rules.integrity: Verify byte length and SHA-256 before parsing. Verify exact int64 parquet schema, no nulls, endpoint IDs against node order, positive counts, signed-count product, consistent presynaptic signs, unique pairs, and independently computed counts.
rules.version_migration: Not automatic. Each interface migration requires separately recorded old/new profile IDs and stable anchor evidence.
